title: Lenstify
tagline: Lenstify is a front-end for Lens with a great interface and many features.
description:
Lenstify is a LensHub front-end client.

Features: 

- Sign-in with the API and Metamask

- Search

- Explore publications

- Create Profile

- Select Profile 

- Timeline

- My publications

- Recommended Profiles

- Follow Profiles

- Mirror publication

-  Markdown

- Comments

- Infinite timeline

- Create comment

-Collect publication

- Explore filter

- Edit profile

- Create Profile with input

- User page

- Set profile avatar, module etc

- Post Publication

- Share location

- Post image

- Post feeling
how_its_made: The project is built in NextJS and it's using the Lens  GraphQL API and the deployed Lens smart contracts on Polygon Mumbai. The project is using Apollo client, Chakra UI, custom react hooks and a custom layout. Using Lens protocol  to build a fast social app was an amazing experience
